name: CIG Raton Basin Expansion (2001)
researcher_notes: Existing row P0168 is the whole CIG system (6920 km); no row for the Raton Basin 2001 expansion, so new expansion-shaped row. EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 198: CIG Raton Basin Expansion, Colorado Interstate Gas Co, Expansion, Completed, in service 2001-10-01, states CO,TX,OK,NM,TX, 70 mi, 83 MMcf/d additional, 20 in, FERC CP00-452. FERC notice (Federal Register 2000-09-20, FR Doc 00-24093) confirms application CP00-452-000: about 48 mi of 20-inch loop from Morton Compressor Station, Morton County Kansas to Hooker Traps, Texas County Oklahoma, plus a separate 21 mi of 8-inch loop Keyes to Campo (gas quality project), together about 69 mi, plus new Trinidad and Kim compressor stations; capacity +85 MDth/d; cost $51,784,900 for the expansion and $4,507,600 for gas quality facilities. Both sources are public FERC-related records but EIA is derived from the FERC filing, so independence is weak. Length 70 mi is EIA's figure and exceeds 25 km threshold; it mixes 20 in and 8 in loops, so diameter 20 in applies to the 48 mi main loop. Cost is the notice's proposed cost, not actual. In-service date from EIA only. Start and end are the 48 mi main loop endpoints from the notice. EIA state list is garbled (TX, NM) and is not used. Owner at the time was CIG; P0168 now shows Kinder Morgan, current owner ref not verified here, so owner left as source spells it. Route not researched; no route. Tier medium: length and in-service from one origin. Related separate expansions (2002 CP02-6, 2005 CP05-50, 2007, 2010) are other candidates, not covered here.
